newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bank lending rises 6.77 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bank lending rises 6.77 pct in June.

text.p: Growth in Venezuelan commercial bank lending slowed in the month of June, rising 6.77 percent to 3.5 trillion bolivars ($6.7 billion), the Softline consultancy said on Wednesday.
Lending had jumped 9.7 percent during May. It has risen 1.082 trillion bolivars, or 48.76 percent, in the first six months of the year, Softline said.
According to the firm's monthly report on 40 commercial banks, total deposits rose six percent to 6.072 trillion bolivars ($12.4 billion).
Banco Provincial topped the list of deposit holders, with 1.4 trillion bolivars, followed by Banco Mercantil with 826 billion bolivars, and Banco de Venezuela with 557 billion bolivars.
